newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Petronas says buys Dai Hung stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Petronas says buys Dai Hung stake.

text.p: Malaysia's state-owned oil and gas producer Petroliam Nasional Bhd (Petronas) confirmed on Tuesday that it had acquired a 43.75 percent stake in Vietnam's Dai Hung offshore oil project.
"We can confirm that Petronas has bought a 43.75 percent stake in the Dai Hung offshore oil project in Vietnam from Broken Hill Propriety Co. Ltd. (BHP)," a Petronas spokesman told Reuters.

Press reports in Australia said the deal had been completed in principle by the two parties, and was awaiting ratification by the Vietnamese government, before being approved by the board of BHP in Melbourne.

Petronas already owns a 20 percent stake in Dai Hung. The additional 43.75 percent stake makes Petronas the largest shareholder in the field. The Vietnamese government's PetroVietnam has 15 percent and Total Sa and Sumitomo Corp have 10.625 percent each.
According to initial estimates, Dai Hung had recoverable oil reserves of 700 million barrels, but this was later revised down to 100 million barrels.
